_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — the tool does NOT read this file. To override defaults, copy it to ~/.config/gh-pr-notifier/config.json (or set GH_PR_NOTIFIER_CONFIG). Every key is optional; precedence is env var > config.json > built-in default. Keep ONLY the keys you want to change and delete the rest. With no config.json at all, sensible defaults are used.
_paths_comment: ADVANCED — usually OMIT these. They auto-default correctly: editor settings under ~/Library/Application Support/Code, state+icon next to the script, gh/terminal-notifier resolved from the plist/PATH. Set them only to override, using REAL absolute paths (the <...> below are placeholders, not valid values).
stateDir: <abs path to a writable state dir>
